brief: Out of 1,307 parcels screened, we identified 273 actionable opportunities and selected four high-scoring sites for outreach this week. These priority acquisitions leverage 485-x tax exemptions, City of Yes UAP density bumps, ground-lease joint ventures, and municipal RFP pipelines. Each selected site demonstrates strong headroom and a clear path to closing.

targets.play: Develop a 7-unit residential project utilizing 485-x Option C for a 10-year tax exemption with market rents and 50 percent rent-stabilized units.
targets.negotiation: Offer up to the max offer of $1,047,948 against an estimated land cost of $952,680, backed by 1.96 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify existing site condition and structural boundaries prior to sending the offer letter.

targets.play: Construct a 19-unit residential project using City of Yes UAP for a 20 percent FAR bump stacked with 485-x tax benefits.
targets.negotiation: Cap outreach at a max offer of $2,771,411 against an estimated land cost of $2,519,465 with 1.76 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify sewer capacity and zoning overlay requirements for the full FAR bump.

targets.play: Structure a ground-lease joint venture with the faith-owned landowner serving as the 51 percent qualified partner required for HPD Neighborhood Builders Fast Track.
targets.negotiation: Frame the joint venture terms around the estimated land value of $353,574 and a max offer valuation of $388,931 with 6.54 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify institutional-owner board approval and governance sign-off.

targets.play: Position for a 67-unit development leveraging City of Yes UAP 20 percent FAR bump and 485-x benefits through city land disposition.
targets.negotiation: Do not make a private cash offer; contact the local Council member and Community Board to track the RFP pipeline.
targets.risk: Verify municipal disposition status and HPD Fast Track RFP release schedules.

process_note: Diligence teams will verify zoning, site conditions, and ownership records before offer letters and public outreach commence.
